format: single new ground-up build Primrose School (New-Build School, typical one-story; excludes land acquisition)

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin ownership of a Primrose ® franchise for a new, ground-up build School is $5,016,600 to $7,960,300. This includes $175,000 to $273,000 that must be paid to the franchisor or an affiliate.

fee.quote: The initial franchise fee for a Primrose franchise (the "Initial Fee") for a new franchisee for a new School is $80,000. If you are an existing franchisee that meets our qualifications, the Initial Fee for a new School will be $70,000.
fee.note: Existing franchisees $70,000; VetFran veterans/U.S. Armed Forces $50,000 for the first School; buyer of an existing School pays 60% of the then-current existing-franchisee fee. Also paid to franchisor: Real Estate Fee $25,000 to $70,000 depending on program, Initial Training Fee $35,000, plus reimbursement of Development Expenses (with 10% interest) under the Real Estate Development and Permanent Lease Programs.

royalty.quote: Continuing Services and Royalty Fee (the "Royalty Fee") 7% of Gross Revenues Payable monthly on the 10th day of the next month

adFund.quote: Brand Fund Fee Currently, 2% of Gross Revenues, but may be increased by us at any time, but not more than a total of 3% of Gross Revenues ... Local Advertising 1% of Gross Revenues for the preceding month or $1,000, whichever is greater
adFund.note: Brand Fund currently 2%, up to 3%. Local advertising spend: greater of 1% of Gross Revenues or $1,000 per month. Cooperatives (up to 1%, up to 2% by vote) exist in markets with ten or more Schools but are being dissolved as of June 30, 2026. Grand opening minimum $75,000 to $100,000.

otherRecurring.name: Local Advertising (minimum spend)
otherRecurring.amount: 1% of Gross Revenues for the preceding month or $1,000, whichever is greater

otherRecurring.name: Computer maintenance, support and upgrades (franchisor estimate)

transferFee.amount: For any Control Transfer, (i) you must pay a transfer fee of 40% of the then-current Initial Fee for existing franchisees purchasing a new School, plus all costs and expenses incurred by us and (ii) your transferee must pay a non-refundable Initial Fee equal to 60% of the then-current Initial Fee for existing franchisees purchasing a new School. Transfer Training and Support Fee currently $35,000.

special: Very high capital project: development costs $4,254,600 to $6,202,500 for a new build, often owned through a Real Estate Affiliate, plus reimbursement to the franchisor of its Development Expenses with 10% interest. An affiliate (PSFC) may give a limited rent guarantee for a 5% fee. Royalty and Brand Fund are charged on billed tuition at franchisor-prescribed billing and discount limits, whether or not collected. Item 19 shows EBITDA after rent from 8.2% (bottom quartile) to 21.6% (top quartile) of revenue, before owner pay and debt service.
issues: No all-School average/median AGR or overall EBITDA margin is printed (only quartiles), so headline value and profitPct are null. Item 19 says 558 Schools open at end of 2025 while Item 20 Table 1 shows 557. Transfer fee only as a % (40% of existing-franchisee fee), no dollar figure. Issuance date taken from 'We issued this Disclosure Document on April 24, 2026'.
